coverage_map_rule: Retain all twenty V1 pass families, but derive applicability from a predeclared task contract; require evidence integrity rather than receipt-controlled conditions or free-text DONE assertions.
retained_candidate_policy: Every catalog family must be considered for relevance. Retention is not mandatory operational use or validation. Preserve all versions, misses and endpoint restrictions.
finite_corpus_policy: Completeness is relative to a frozen edition/section/technique inventory, never to all possible astrology.
timing_information_rule: Freeze forecasts before outcomes. Future ephemeris positions known at issue time may be used under the frozen model; later outcome observations or post-outcome parameter choices may not. Historical candidate rules remain unchanged.
validator_scope: Verifies identity/reference integrity and declared execution coverage. Does not certify semantic entailment, actual blinding, author authenticity, astronomical correctness or scientific validity.
next_source_stage: Acquire editions, inventory all sections, extract conditional RuleSpecs with exceptions and dependencies, then implement and replay source examples before new-person application.
catalog_disposition_rule: Exactly cover current, exploratory and negative/superseded catalog entries; selected entries link to real planned modules. Machine checks membership, not semantic adequacy of relevance judgments.
